title: Evaluation of Summarization Systems across Gender, Age, and Race

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating summarization system performance using automated metrics (ROUGE) against reference summaries authored by different genders, and analyzing system preferences and ratings (fluency, informativeness, usefulness) from human judges based on their self-reported gender.

Evaluating summarization system performance using automated metrics against reference summaries authored by different age groups (under 30 vs. 30 and older), and analyzing human rater preferences and Likert-scale evaluations across these age demographics.

Evaluating summarization system performance using automated metrics against reference summaries authored by different racial groups, and analyzing human rater preferences and qualitative judgments across different self-reported racial demographics.
